reviews.text: Really nice menu, fast service, Hannah was fantastic and really helpful with recommendations and a font of knowledge about the menu and flavour profiles of the dishes! Great service

reviews.author: Georgie Hahn-Haas
reviews.text: The perfect place for a casual dinner or a relaxed date! I really enjoyed my meal at Maki & Ramen - the service was fast and friendly (thanks Harry!) and there were so many delicious food options to choose from, including seasonal specials! I decided to go with the black garlic tonkotsu ramen, which was incredibly good value for the portion size! The flavours were excellent, the noodles were a perfect al dente and the broth was divine (I had to stop myself from licking the bowl at the end of the meal!) I could not recommend this place more, will definitely be back next time I’m in Edinburgh! 🍜🍱🍣

reviews.author: Ben Hildebrandt
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) The food is generally good, but there are definitely better ramen places. However, you have to be careful when paying, as a 10% service charge is added immediately and cannot be easily changed afterward. Given the already high prices, this unfortunately creates a somewhat negative impression, even though the restaurant itself is good. (Original) Das Essen ist grundsätzlich gut, aber es gibt durchaus bessere Ramen-Lokalitäten. Beim Bezahlen muss man allerdings aufpassen, da sofort 10% Trinkgeld berechnet werden und diese hinterher nicht mehr einfach geändert werden können. Bei den nicht gerade günstigen Preisen erweckt das leider einen etwas schlechten Eindruck obwohl die Lokalität grundsätzlich gut ist.

reviews.text: Went with my sister for lunch the other day. Food was absolutely amazing as always but sadly the service was horrible. Almost every time iv been to this location so far despite it being quite quiet when I go we end up left waiting for service for ages with the shortest being 25 minutes waiting for our bill after they took our plates. This time after they had taken our plates and cups my sister an I were left for a whole hour without a single person coming over to ask for the bill and when we where about to ask someone for the bill they were always shooting past us. I understand being a server is a hard job but leaving a table for an hour while another table was sat beside us given their food and paid within that time is ridiculous. And when we mentioned it while paying all we got was an annoyed look from the staff.

reviews.text: Went for the first time today. Had the tonkatsu ramen and salmon sushi. Sushi was nice. It had a lightly fried batter outer which gave it a nice crisp crunch and the cooked salmon centre was nice too. Sadly the wasabi on the side that it came with was more sweet than hot. Personally I like my wasabi hot. Then the ramen as my main, all I can really say is it was exceedingly mid. The broth. Was nice, not particularly salty or strong but it was nice. The noodles didn’t really absorb much of the flavour though and the pork while flavourful was a bit tough. To answer the question of would I have if all again, then the answer would be no sadly. I also personally hate when they automatically add a service charge to the bill, forcing you to have to ask to have it removed.

reviews.author: Jane West
reviews.text: Enthusiastic welcome upon entering with a gong flourish- nice touch. I had the spicy seafood tom yum ramen, the broth flavor was excellent, the seafood itself was not. The shrimp and salmon were grilled first so they had a grilled taste that didn’t work in the broth. The salmon was overcooked, primarily because it was thin sashimi slices standing in for an actual salmon filet. The squid was questionable rubbery white rolls. None of the seafood was worth eating. My son on the other hand, had sushi and loved it. So maybe keep the seafood raw and out of the ramen broth? Gyoza was tasty. Service was friendly and atmosphere warm & playful. The post-it notes on the wall I guess appeal to some, I thought maybe more appropriate in a bathroom stall.

The team even brought out a birthday mochi and sang for us, which made the night extra special. A big thank you to Hong S, who was so patient with our large order. We were new to Maki, and she took the time to explain the menu and make recommendations. She was warm, friendly and made us feel really looked after. Definitely recommend for group dining and celebrations.

He was excellent from start to finish, the food arrived quickly and was delicious, I had to wait a little longer for dessert but it was worth the wait. I definitely recommend coming here. The ambiance and design of the establishment are very eye-catching from the outside, which is a plus. (Original) Me ha atendido Navin W. Me ha atendido muy bien de principio a fin, la comida ha llegado rapido y deliciosa, el postre he tenido que esperar un poco más pero ha valido la pena la espera. Sin duda recomiendo venir. El ambiente y el diseño del establecimiento llama mucho la atención desde fuera lo que le da un punto a favor.

reviews.author: Ashraf Ali
reviews.text: I went yesterday for the first time for my 10 year anniversary. Food is fantastic- zero complaints My issue was the website offer a lunch deal that I thought was such value for money. I got there and sat down at 12pm and they told me they are not offering the lunch menu for christmas! Wait we are in november its not christmas and second why plaster it on your website if your no longer offering it. This is what you call sly tactics and I hate businesses that do that. Would I visit again? Maybe cause the food was really good but I dont trust them!

reviews.author: Sponge
reviews.text: Service was diabolical, which i dont think was a fault of the junior staff but from poor management. I did note a few individuals who I sussed were management having a bit of an attitude towards their junior staff members. The food came out in staggered stages. People who had arrived some time after us received the whole of their order before ours was complete. The ramen was brought out first, luke warm. Ages later the remainder of our order followed. Our stomachs are playing up today and I believe this to be a fault of food temperatures. Was the kicthen understaffed, who knows. I have been to many ramen restaurants and unfortunately this wasnt great. The toilets were disgusting, clearly not checked throughout the day. Overall, a poor experience, which is a shame really.
